pandas.plotting.bootstrap_plot

pandas 3.1.1 · Plotting · function

Plot sample statistics for repeated bootstrap resamples to explore their variation.

  • Call syntax
  • Inspect the call
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.plotting.bootstrap_plot(series, fig=None, size=50, samples=500, **kwds)

Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib

values = pd.Series([3, 5, 9, 11, 14, 15, 17, 19])
print(pd.plotting.bootstrap_plot(values, size=4, samples=8))
